findings.title: Return leads into disclosure

findings.mechanism: Marjiʿuhum names the return, and the following fa attaches nunabbiʾuhum as its consequence; bi-mā ʿamilū supplies the report's content.

findings.title: Two responses are sequenced

epistemic.reason: Both connector positions and their local clauses are visible in the focus morphology and candidate evidence.
